text:
Garlic butter chimichurri steak bites ✨

Ingredients 
Steak
- 2 pounds ribeye or sirloin steak, cubed
- 1 tbsp neutral oil
- 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce 
- 2 tsp garlic powder 
- 2 tsp @kindersflavors buttery steakhouse seasoning 
- 1 tsp kosher salt (or to taste)
- 1/2 tsp black pepper 
- 2 tbsp Kerrygold garlic & herb butter

Chimichurri 
- 1 bunch fresh Italian parsley, finely chopped (about 1 cup packed)
- 2 Fresno chiles, finely diced 
- 4 garlic cloves, minced
- 2 tbsp red wine vinegar
- 3/4 cup extra virgin olive oil
- 2 tsp dried oregano
- 1 tsp kosher salt
- 1 tsp red chili flakes 
- Juice of 1/2 lemon (optional )

Garlic Parmesan mashed potatoes 
- 6 medium Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and quartered (about 2½–3 lbs)
- 2 cups half-and-half (use as needed)
- 4 garlic cloves, lightly smashed 
- 2 bay leaves 
- 3–4 sprigs fresh thyme
- 4 tbsp (1/2 stick) Kerrygold Garlic & Herb Butter 
- 1/3 cup sour cream
- 3/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese 
- 2 tsp garlic powder
- 1 1/2 tsp kosher salt, plus more for the potato water
- 1/2 tsp freshly cracked black pepper
